2.en:
When soil is tired, find out what is limiting growth. Water, soil structure and different nutrients can all matter.

Legumes can fix nitrogen through their partnership with rhizobia. Mulch returns plant material to the soil, and flowers can support helpful insects.

Choose each plant for the conditions and the job your garden actually needs.
2.zu:
Uma umhlabathi usukhathele, thola okuvimbela ukukhula. Amanzi, ukwakheka komhlabathi nezakhamzimba ezahlukene konke kungaba nomthelela.

Ama-legumes angabopha i-nitrogen ngokusebenzisana nama-rhizobia. I-mulch ibuyisela izinsalela zezitshalo emhlabathini, kanti izimbali zingasekela izinambuzane eziwusizo.

Khetha isitshalo ngasinye ngokwezimo nomsebenzi odingwa yingadi yakho.

4.en:
Legumes partner with soil bacteria called rhizobia in root nodules. The bacteria convert nitrogen from the air into forms the legume can use.

Nitrogen in cut leaves and dead roots returns to the soil as organisms decompose that material. Cutting does not make all of it immediately available to neighbouring crops.
4.zu:
Ama-legumes asebenzisana namabhaktheriya omhlabathi abizwa ngama-rhizobia kuma-nodule asezimpandeni. La mabhaktheriya aguqula i-nitrogen esemoyeni ibe yindlela i-legume engayisebenzisa.

I-nitrogen esemacembeni asikiwe nasezimpandeni ezifile ibuyela emhlabathini njengoba izidalwa zomhlabathi zibolisa lezo zinsalela. Ukusika akuyenzi yonke itholakale ngokushesha ezitshalweni eziseduze.

5.en:
Look at the nodules on the legume root. Rhizobia help the legume use nitrogen from the air.

Follow the separate decomposition stage: cut material and dead roots release nutrients as they break down.
5.zu:
Bheka ama-nodule asempandeni ye-legume. Ama-rhizobia asiza i-legume isebenzise i-nitrogen esemoyeni.

Landela isigaba esihlukile sokubola: izinsalela ezisikiwe nezimpande ezifile zikhipha izakhamzimba njengoba zibola.

7.en:
Sunn hemp is a fast-growing annual legume for suitable warm conditions.

Its growth and nitrogen contribution depend on the stand, nodulation, soil and season. Do not budget a fixed fertiliser saving from the crop name alone.

After cutting, decomposition takes time. Moisture, temperature and the material itself affect nutrient release; check local guidance before planting the next crop.
7.zu:
I-sunn hemp yi-legume yonyaka ekhula ngokushesha ezimweni ezifudumele ezifanele.

Ukukhula kwayo nenani le-nitrogen elengezayo kuncike esitshalweni esikhona, kuma-nodule, emhlabathini nasesizini. Ungahleleli ukonga umanyolo ngenani elinqunyiwe ngenxa yegama lesitshalo kuphela.

Ngemva kokusika, ukubola kuthatha isikhathi. Umswakama, izinga lokushisa nezinsalela uqobo kuthinta ukukhishwa kwezakhamzimba; hlola iseluleko sendawo ngaphambi kwesitshalo esilandelayo.

8.en:
Place nitrogen fixers where their mature size, shade and water needs fit the fruit trees and paths. Leave access for cutting and carrying mulch.

Do not rely on wind or downhill movement to deliver fertility to a tree. Return suitable cut material where mulch is needed.

Sesbania sesban is a short-lived shrub or small tree, not an annual. Thin or prune support plants when observation shows increasing competition.
8.zu:
Beka izitshalo ezibopha i-nitrogen lapho ubukhulu bazo uma sezikhulile, umthunzi nezidingo zamanzi kuhambisana nezihlahla zezithelo nezindlela. Shiya indawo yokungena ukusika nokuthwala i-mulch.

Ungathembeli emoyeni noma ekugelezeni kokwehla ukuthi kulethe ukuvunda esihlahleni. Beka izinsalela ezifanele lapho kudingeka khona i-mulch.

I-Sesbania sesban yisihlahla esincane esiphila iminyaka embalwa, ayisona isitshalo sonyaka. Nciphisa noma usike izitshalo ezisekelayo uma ubona ukuncintisana kukhula.

12.en:
Many ladybirds eat aphids, and some parasitoid wasps attack caterpillars.

Flowering plants such as African basil, borage and marigold can provide resources for useful insects. Observe which insects actually visit and whether crop damage changes.

Flowers support pest management; they do not guarantee that an outbreak will stop. Use the Vegetables lesson to inspect damage and choose an appropriate response.
12.zu:
Ama-ladybird amaningi adla ama-aphid, kanti amanye ama-parasitoid wasp ahlasela ama-caterpillar.

Izitshalo eziqhakazayo njenge-African basil, i-borage ne-marigold zingasekela izinambuzane eziwusizo. Bheka izinambuzane ezifika ngempela nokuthi umonakalo ezitshalweni uyashintsha yini.

Izimbali zisekela ukuphathwa kwezinambuzane; aziqinisekisi ukuthi ukuhlasela kuzophela. Sebenzisa isifundo seMifino ukuhlola umonakalo nokukhetha isinyathelo esifanele.

13.en:
Wild garlic, Tulbaghia violacea, is a drought-tolerant flowering plant for suitable sites. Its leaves and flowers have food uses when correctly identified.

Use it as part of a diverse planting, and observe insect visits. Do not promise that a ring of wild garlic will repel aphids or whitefly or cure an existing infestation.
13.zu:
I-wild garlic, i-Tulbaghia violacea, yisitshalo esiqhakazayo esibekezelela isomiso ezindaweni ezifanele. Amaqabunga nezimbali zayo kuyasetshenziswa ekudleni uma ihlonzwe kahle.

Yisebenzise phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene, ubheke izinambuzane ezivakashelayo. Ungathembisi ukuthi indilinga ye-wild garlic izoxosha ama-aphid noma i-whitefly noma iqede ukuhlasela okukhona.
13.title: Wild Garlic in a Diverse Planting

14.en:
A plant guild is a group chosen to support a central tree, usually fruit or nut.

Members can produce food, fix nitrogen, supply mulch, support useful insects or cover the ground.

The plants still share light, water and space. Observe the guild, water during establishment and adjust plants that crowd the tree.
14.zu:
I-plant guild yiqembu lezitshalo elikhethwe ukusekela umuthi ophakathi, imvamisa wezithelo noma wamantongomane.

Amalungu angakhiqiza ukudla, abophe i-nitrogen, anike i-mulch, asekele izinambuzane eziwusizo noma amboze umhlabathi.

Izitshalo zisabelana ngokukhanya, amanzi nendawo. Bheka i-guild, uyinisele ngesikhathi isasungulwa, ulungise izitshalo eziminyanisa umuthi.

16.en:
For the mango example, assess sunlight and the mature size of Sesbania sesban before choosing its position. Keep room to reach both plants.

Pruning supplies mulch and can reduce shade. It does not end root competition for water and nutrients. Adjust pruning or spacing as the trees grow.

Place Bocking 14 comfrey where it has room to grow and be cut, keeping the mango trunk and root collar clear of mulch.
16.zu:
Esibonelweni se-mango, hlola ukukhanya nobukhulu be-Sesbania sesban uma isikhulile ngaphambi kokukhetha indawo yayo. Shiya indawo yokufinyelela kuzo zombili izitshalo.

Ukuthena kunika i-mulch futhi kunganciphisa umthunzi. Akuqedi ukuncintisana kwezimpande ngamanzi nezakhamzimba. Lungisa ukuthena noma izikhala njengoba izihlahla zikhula.

Beka i-Bocking 14 comfrey lapho inendawo yokukhula nokusikwa, ugcine isiqu nendawo lapho isiqu sihlangana nezimpande ze-mango kungenayo i-mulch.

17.en:
Use wild garlic and African basil as flowering members where the site suits them. Watch which useful insects visit.

Sweet potato can cover ground and provide food, but its vines and roots also need space and water. Keep access to the mango clear.

Judge each plant by what it does in your garden; no companion plant guarantees control of fruit flies or other pests.
17.zu:
Sebenzisa i-wild garlic ne-African basil njengezitshalo eziqhakazayo lapho indawo izifanele. Bheka izinambuzane eziwusizo ezivakashelayo.

I-sweet potato ingamboza umhlabathi inike ukudla, kodwa iziqu nezimpande zayo nazo zidinga indawo namanzi. Gcina indlela yokufinyelela ku-mango ivulekile.

Hlulela isitshalo ngasinye ngalokho esikwenzayo engadini yakho; asikho isitshalo esihambisana nezinye esiqinisekisa ukulawula ama-fruit fly noma ezinye izinambuzane.

18.en:
Give every guild plant a clear job and enough room to do it.

A ground cover can protect soil and provide food, but it can also compete with a young tree. Compare it with mulch where water is limited.

Record growth, shade, soil moisture and crop damage. Change the guild when the evidence shows that a member needs more space or different care.
18.zu:
Nikeza isitshalo ngasinye se-guild umsebenzi ocacile nendawo eyanele yokuwenza.

Isitshalo esimboza umhlabathi singawuvikela sinike nokudla, kodwa singancintisana nomuthi omncane. Siqhathanise ne-mulch lapho amanzi enganele.

Bhala ukukhula, umthunzi, umswakama womhlabathi nomonakalo ezitshalweni. Shintsha i-guild uma ubufakazi bubonisa ukuthi ilungu lidinga indawo eyengeziwe noma ukunakekelwa okuhlukile.

6.en:
The seven layers describe planting roles, not fixed heights for every species.

Canopy and sub-canopy trees rise above shrubs and herbaceous plants. Ground covers spread over the surface, root crops grow below, and climbers use a suitable support.

Check mature size and light needs before fitting these layers together.
6.zu:
Izingqimba eziyisikhombisa zichaza imisebenzi yezitshalo, hhayi ukuphakama okufanayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo.

Izihlahla ze-canopy ne-sub-canopy ziphakeme kunezihlahla ezincane nezitshalo ezithambile. Izitshalo ezimbozayo zisakazeka ebusweni, izilimo zezimpande zikhula ngaphansi, kanti ezikhwelayo zisebenzisa into efanele yokusekelwa.

Hlola ubukhulu uma sezikhulile nezidingo zokukhanya ngaphambi kokuhlanganisa lezi zingqimba.

7.en:
Use this as a design example, not a planting list for every Highveld farm.

A Wild Fig or pecan may occupy the canopy, with suitable smaller trees, shrubs and food crops below.

Check each species and cultivar against your frost, available water, mature size and light. Frost-sensitive plants such as granadilla need particular care in a cold site.
7.zu:
Sebenzisa lokhu njengesibonelo sokuhlela, hhayi uhlu lokutshala kuwo wonke amapulazi ase-Highveld.

I-Wild Fig noma i-pecan ingaba ku-canopy, kube nezihlahla ezincane, izihlahlana nezitshalo zokudla ezifanele ngaphansi.

Hlola uhlobo ngalunye ne-cultivar ngokwesithwathwa, amanzi atholakalayo, ubukhulu nokukhanya. Izitshalo ezizwela isithwathwa njenge-granadilla zidinga ukuqashelwa endaweni ebandayo.

8.en:
The first years need steady establishment work: watering, mulch, weed control and protection.

As trees grow, shade and leaf litter can reduce evaporation from the soil surface. They also change how much light and water the lower plants receive.

There is no fixed year when every food forest looks after itself. Keep observing, pruning and adjusting the planting.
8.zu:
Iminyaka yokuqala idinga umsebenzi oqhubekayo: ukunisela, i-mulch, ukulawula ukhula nokuvikela izitshalo.

Njengoba izihlahla zikhula, umthunzi namaqabunga awile kunganciphisa ukuhwamuka kwamanzi ebusweni bomhlabathi. Kushintsha nokukhanya namanzi okutholwa izitshalo ezingezansi.

Awukho unyaka omisiwe lapho lonke ihlathi lokudla lizizinakekela khona. Qhubeka ubheka, uthena futhi ulungisa okutshalwe khona.
8.title: From Establishment to Ongoing Care

9.en:
Match each species and cultivar to your site before planting.

Record rainfall, minimum winter temperature, frost frequency, summer humidity and available water.

A young mango can be badly damaged by frost; shelter does not guarantee protection. A quince cultivar may need winter chilling your site cannot supply. Ask a local grower or nursery to check the match.
9.zu:
Qhathanisa uhlobo ngalunye ne-cultivar nendawo yakho ngaphambi kokutshala.

Bhala imvula, izinga lokushisa eliphansi ebusika, ukuthi isithwathwa sivela kangaki, umswakama wasehlobo namanzi atholakalayo.

I-mango encane ingalimala kakhulu yisithwathwa; indawo evikelekile ayiqinisekisi ukuvikeleka. I-quince cultivar ingadinga amakhaza asebusika indawo yakho engenawo. Cela umlimi wendawo noma i-nursery ihlole ukufaneleka.

11.en:
The lesson names pecan, walnut, indigenous fig, apple, pear, plum, black mulberry, rosemary, Wild Medlar and Cape gooseberry as candidates to assess.

Confirm the cultivar, mature size and local frost and water needs before buying. Barbados cherry is not a default choice for a frosty Highveld site.

Check current restrictions before planting loquat; do not plant it in the Western Cape or forest biome. Do not use a regional list as planting permission.
11.zu:
Lesi sifundo sibiza i-pecan, i-walnut, i-indigenous fig, i-apple, i-pear, i-plum, i-black mulberry, i-rosemary, i-Wild Medlar ne-Cape gooseberry njengezitshalo okufanele uzihlole.

Qinisekisa i-cultivar, ubukhulu nezidingo zesithwathwa namanzi ngaphambi kokuthenga. I-Barbados cherry ayiyona inketho ezenzakalelayo endaweni yase-Highveld enesithwathwa.

Hlola imikhawulo yamanje ngaphambi kokutshala i-loquat; ungayitshali e-Western Cape noma e-forest biome. Uhlu lwesifunda alusiyo imvume yokutshala.

12.en:
Warm coastal and Lowveld sites may suit the mango, avocado, banana, pawpaw and litchi already named in this lesson. Check local conditions and mature size for each.

The lesson also names Natal Mahogany, Wild Fig, Barbados cherry, Wild Dagga, Marula, Mopane and baobab for different regional roles. These names are not a claim that every plant or every part is edible.

Confirm the exact plant, its purpose and any food preparation with a reliable local source before using it.
12.zu:
Izindawo ezifudumele zasogwini nase-Lowveld zingafanele i-mango, i-avocado, i-banana, i-pawpaw ne-litchi ezibizwe kulesi sifundo. Hlola izimo zendawo nobukhulu bohlobo ngalunye uma selukhulile.

Isifundo sibiza ne-Natal Mahogany, i-Wild Fig, i-Barbados cherry, i-Wild Dagga, i-Marula, i-Mopane ne-baobab ngemisebenzi ehlukene yezifunda. La magama awasho ukuthi zonke izitshalo noma zonke izingxenye ziyadliwa.

Qinisekisa isitshalo esiqondile, umsebenzi waso nendlela yokulungisa ukudla ngomthombo wendawo othembekile ngaphambi kokusisebenzisa.

13.en:
Include suitable indigenous plants that support local birds and insects as well as your household goals.

The earlier 30% figure is a course planning target, not a universal ecological threshold. The species, placement and conditions matter.

Observe flowering, visitors, crop damage and growth. Use that evidence to improve the mix.
13.zu:
Faka izitshalo zendabuko ezifanele ezisekela izinyoni nezinambuzane zendawo kanye nezinhloso zomuzi wakho.

Isibalo sangaphambili sika-30% siyinhloso yokuhlela yalesi sifundo, hhayi umkhawulo wemvelo osebenza yonke indawo. Izinhlobo, indawo yokuzibeka nezimo kubalulekile.

Bheka ukuqhakaza, izivakashi, umonakalo ezitshalweni nokukhula. Sebenzisa lobo bufakazi ukuthuthukisa inhlanganisela.

16.en:
For the 500m² practice plot, assess weeds, drainage and water before choosing the first stage.

If sheet mulching suits the site, use clean, uncoated cardboard with tape and staples removed, and cover it with suitable mulch. Keep water able to reach the soil and leave tree trunks clear.

Choose pioneer spacing from mature size and access needs. Start a nursery for the next stage; one fixed spacing and mulch depth will not suit every plot.
16.zu:
Endaweni yokuzivocavoca engu-500m², hlola ukhula, ukuphuma kwamanzi namanzi atholakalayo ngaphambi kokukhetha isigaba sokuqala.

Uma i-sheet mulch ifanele indawo, sebenzisa amakhadibhodi ahlanzekile angafakwanga ungqimba olucwebezelayo, ususe i-tape nama-staple, uwamboze nge-mulch efanele. Vumela amanzi afike emhlabathini, ugcine iziqu zezihlahla zingamboziwe.

Khetha izikhala zezihlahla zokuqala ngokobukhulu nezidingo zokungena. Qala i-nursery yesigaba esilandelayo; isikhala nokujula kwe-mulch okukodwa akufanele zonke izindawo.

17.en:
Use the planting sequence as a guide, and let the site show when it is ready.

Establish suitable main fruit trees, then add lower plants where light, water and shelter allow.

Thin or prune pioneers before they crowd the fruit trees. Use suitable cuttings as mulch. The right moment depends on growth and competition, not a fixed year.
17.zu:
Sebenzisa ukulandelana kokutshala njengomhlahlandlela, uvumele indawo ibonise ukuthi isilungile nini.

Sungula izihlahla zezithelo ezifanele, bese ufaka izitshalo ezingezansi lapho ukukhanya, amanzi nokuvikeleka kuvuma.

Nciphisa noma uthene izihlahla zokuqala ngaphambi kokuminyanisa zezithelo. Sebenzisa izinsalela ezifanele njenge-mulch. Isikhathi esifanele sincike ekukhuleni nasekuncintisaneni, hhayi onyakeni omisiwe.
17.title: Let Growth Guide the Next Stage

18.en:
Plant when the soil is moist and follow-up water is available. The start of a reliable rainy season can help, but rain may pause.

Check the root zone after planting and water when needed. Mulch helps protect surface moisture; it does not replace establishment care.

Harvest timing and outside inputs depend on the species, planting material, weather and management. Do not promise a full harvest in a fixed year.
18.zu:
Tshala lapho umhlabathi unomswakama futhi kukhona amanzi okunisela kamuva. Ukuqala kwesizini yemvula ethembekile kungasiza, kodwa imvula ingama.

Hlola indawo yezimpande ngemva kokutshala, unisele lapho kudingeka. I-mulch isiza ukuvikela umswakama ongaphezulu; ayithathi indawo yokunakekelwa ngesikhathi sokusungula.

Isikhathi sesivuno nezinto ezithengwa ngaphandle kuncike ohlotsheni, ezitshalweni eziqalwayo, esimweni sezulu nasekunakekelweni. Ungathembisi isivuno esigcwele ngonyaka omisiwe.

6.en:
Some crops do better sown straight where they will grow. Beans, carrots and maize belong in that group. Tomatoes and brassicas can start in a protected nursery before transplanting.

[pause]

Use guidance for the actual crop and cultivar, then check spacing against local soil, water, season and mature size. Do not assume every seed packet was written for a cooler, wetter country. Keep paths and enough room to tend the plants.
6.zu:
Ezinye izitshalo zenza kangcono uma zihlwanyelwa lapho zizokhula khona. Ubhontshisi, izaqathi nommbila kulapho. Utamatisi nama-brassica kungaqala e-nursery evikelekile ngaphambi kokutshalwa kabusha.

[pause]

Sebenzisa iseluleko sesitshalo ne-cultivar oqobo, bese uhlola izikhala ngokomhlabathi, amanzi, isizini nobukhulu uma sesikhulile. Ungacabangi ukuthi zonke izikhwama zembewu zibhalelwe izwe elipholile nelinemvula eningi. Gcina izindlela nendawo eyanele yokunakekela izitshalo.

8.en:
Succession planting is a calendar habit. Choose a crop your household eats often, then sow small amounts at intervals.

Two to three weeks can be a starting rhythm for suitable crops, not a rule for every crop or season. Check days to harvest and record what actually happens.

[pause]

Staggering sowings can spread harvest and labour and reduce reliance on one planting. Heat, drought or pests may still affect several sowings. Adjust the plan from your observations.
8.zu:
Ukutshala ngokulandelana kuwumkhuba wekhalenda. Khetha isitshalo esidliwa njalo ekhaya, bese uhlwanyela kancane ngezikhawu.

Amasonto amabili kuya kwamathathu angaba yisigqi sokuqala sezitshalo ezifanele, hhayi umthetho wesitshalo noma wesizini ngayinye. Hlola izinsuku kuze kuvunwe, ubhale okwenzeka ngempela.

[pause]

Ukuhlukanisa ukuhlwanyela kungasabalalisa isivuno nomsebenzi, kunciphise ukuncika ekutshaleni okukodwa. Ukushisa, isomiso noma izinambuzane kusengathinta ukuhlwanyela okuningi. Lungisa uhlelo ngalokho okubukile.

9.en:
Sow one small batch, record its date, then sow the next when your crop and season call for it.

In a two-to-three-week example, four sowings will be at different stages. The first is not automatically ready when the fourth is planted.

[pause]

Check the crop and cultivar’s harvest time, then compare it with actual growth. Record the first and last harvest dates. Use those dates to adjust the next sowing interval and reduce gaps.
9.zu:
Hlwanyela iqoqo elincane, ubhale usuku, bese uhlwanyela elilandelayo lapho isitshalo nesizini kudinga khona.

Esibonelweni sezikhawu zamasonto amabili kuya kwamathathu, ukuhlwanyela okune kuzoba sezigabeni ezahlukene. Okokuqala akulungeli ukuvunwa ngokuzenzakalela lapho kutshalwa okwesine.

[pause]

Hlola isikhathi sesivuno sesitshalo ne-cultivar, usiqhathanise nokukhula kwangempela. Bhala usuku lwesivuno sokuqala nesokugcina. Sebenzisa lezo zinsuku ukulungisa isikhawu esilandelayo nokunciphisa izikhala zokudla.

10.en:
Intercropping is not just crowding different plants together. Each plant needs a job, and enough space to do it.

The three sisters is the clearest example.

Maize gives height and structure.

Beans climb the maize, and store as protein.

Pumpkin spreads across the ground, shading the soil and holding moisture.

[pause]

Timing matters. Establish the maize first, so it's strong enough to carry the beans when they start to climb.

Three crops share one piece of ground, but they can still compete for light, water and nutrients. Watch their growth and adjust spacing and timing.
10.zu:
Ukuxubanisa izitshalo ezahlukene endaweni eyodwa (intercropping) akusikho nje
ukuminyanisa izitshalo ezahlukene ndawonye. Isitshalo ngasinye sidinga umsebenzi waso,
nendawo eyanele ukuwenza.

Odade Abathathu (Three Sisters — ummbila, izimbotyi, namaphuzi) yisibonelo esicace
kakhulu.

Ummbila unikeza ukuphakama nesakhiwo.

Izimbotyi zikhwela ummbila, futhi zigcinwe njengeprotheni.

Amaphuzi asakazeka phansi emhlabeni, enza umthunzi enhlabathini agcine ukuswakama.

[pause]

Isikhathi siyabaluleka. Qala ngokutshala ummbila kuqala, ukuze ube namandla anele
ukuthwala izimbotyi lapho ziqala ukukhwela.

Izitshalo ezintathu zabelana ngomhlaba owodwa, kodwa zisengancintisana ngokukhanya, amanzi nezakhamzimba. Bheka ukukhula kwazo, ulungise izikhala nesikhathi sokutshala.

2.en:
Small livestock can provide food and useful work, but every animal also needs daily care.

Chickens scratch, ducks forage, and bees visit flowers. These activities may help the farm, but animals can damage crops and contaminate food-growing areas.

Plan feed, clean water, shelter, health care and safe separation from harvested food before adding animals.
2.zu:
Imfuyo emincane inganika ukudla nomsebenzi owusizo, kodwa isilwane ngasinye sidinga ukunakekelwa nsuku zonke.

Izinkukhu ziyagubha, amadada afuna ukudla, kanti izinyosi zivakashela izimbali. Lokhu kungasiza ipulazi, kodwa izilwane zingalimaza izitshalo zingcolise nezindawo zokudla.

Hlela ukudla, amanzi ahlanzekile, indawo yokuhlala, ukunakekelwa kwempilo nokuhlukaniswa nokudla okuvuniwe ngaphambi kokuletha izilwane.

4.en:
Watch the chicken tractor move across an empty bed, with feed, water and shelter kept with the birds.

Scratching disturbs old material and manure stays behind. The bed is not immediately ready for food crops: agree a safe manure and planting plan before the next crop.
4.zu:
Buka i-chicken tractor ihamba embhedeni ongenazitshalo, ukudla, amanzi nendawo yokukhosela kuhlala nezinkukhu.

Ukugubha kuphazamisa izinsalela, umquba usale. Umbhede awulungeli ngokushesha izitshalo zokudla: hlela ukuphepha komquba nokutshala ngaphambi kwesitshalo esilandelayo.

5.en:
Chickens forage and scratch through suitable areas, eating some insects and weed seeds. This does not replace balanced feed or health care.

Manure and bedding can become compost material when handled and composted properly. Fresh manure can carry disease-causing organisms.

Keep birds, manure and dirty equipment away from harvested produce, packing surfaces and growing crops eaten raw. Wash hands after handling birds or manure.
5.zu:
Izinkukhu zifuna ukudla zigubhe ezindaweni ezifanele, zidle ezinye izinambuzane nembewu yokhula. Lokhu akuthathi indawo yokudla okunomsoco ophelele noma ukunakekelwa kwempilo.

Umquba nezinto zokulala kungaba yizinto ze-compost uma kuphathwa kuboliswa ngendlela efanele. Umquba omusha ungathwala izidalwa ezibangela izifo.

Gcina izinkukhu, umquba namathuluzi angcolile kude nomkhiqizo ovuniwe, amatafula okupakisha nezitshalo ezidliwa zingaphekiwe. Geza izandla ngemva kokuphatha izinkukhu noma umquba.

6.en:
Never put chickens around seedlings: scratching can uproot them.

An empty bed after harvest may be part of a rotation only when food safety and animal care are planned. Removing the birds does not remove fresh manure or its risks.

Ask a qualified local adviser about the manure-management and harvest interval required for the next crop. Keep animals out of areas where manure could contact edible produce.
6.zu:
Ungafaki izinkukhu eduze kwezithombo: ukugubha kungazisiphula.

Umbhede ongenalutho ngemva kokuvuna ungaba yingxenye yokushintshanisa kuphela uma kuhleliwe ukuphepha kokudla nokunakekelwa kwezilwane. Ukususa izinkukhu akuwususi umquba omusha noma ubungozi bawo.

Buza umeluleki wendawo oqeqeshiwe ngokuphatha umquba nesikhathi esidingekayo ngaphambi kwesivuno esilandelayo. Gcina izilwane ngaphandle kwezindawo lapho umquba ungathinta khona ukudla okuvuniwayo.

7.en:
Ducks eat slugs and snails without the heavy scratching typical of chickens.

They can still trample plants, foul water and leave manure. An established understorey is not automatically safe for ducks.

Plan a suitable managed area with clean drinking water, shelter and adequate feed. Keep them away from produce and water used for food handling.
7.zu:
Amadada adla ama-slug neminenke ngaphandle kokugubha kakhulu njengenkukhu.

Asenganyathela izitshalo, angcolise amanzi futhi ashiye umquba. Indawo engaphansi kwezihlahla esisunguliwe ayiphephile ngokuzenzakalela emadadeni.

Hlela indawo efanele ephethwe kahle enamanzi okuphuza ahlanzekile, indawo yokukhosela nokudla okwanele. Wagcine kude nomkhiqizo namanzi asetshenziswa ekuphatheni ukudla.
7.title: Manage Ducks Around Growing Areas

8.en:
Move a chicken tractor according to bird welfare, ground condition, weather and the farm’s manure plan. Inspect it daily.

Do not keep birds in mud, overcrowding, heat or exhausted ground while waiting for a calendar date. Keep feed, water, shade and predator protection available.

A fixed number of hens on a fixed plot cannot guarantee all its fertiliser needs. Use soil and crop evidence to judge fertility.
8.zu:
Hambisa i-chicken tractor ngokwenhlalakahle yezinkukhu, isimo somhlabathi, isimo sezulu nohlelo lomquba lwepulazi. Yihlole nsuku zonke.

Ungagcini izinkukhu odakeni, ziminyene, ekushiseni noma emhlabathini osuphelile ulinde usuku lwekhalenda. Gcina ukudla, amanzi, umthunzi nokuvikelwa ezilwaneni ezizingelayo kutholakala.

Inani elinqunyiwe lezinkukhu endaweni enqunyiwe aliqinisekisi zonke izidingo zomanyolo. Sebenzisa ubufakazi bomhlabathi nezitshalo ukuhlola ukuvunda.

10.en:
Bees and other flower visitors help pollinate many food crops. Dependence on insect visits differs between crops and cultivars.

In avocado, flowers have female and male phases. Suitable flowering overlap and pollen movement can support fruit set, but weather and tree condition matter too.

Observe flowers and visitors before assuming a hive alone will solve poor fruit set.
10.zu:
Izinyosi nezinye izivakashi zezimbali zisiza ukuthutha impova ezitshalweni zokudla eziningi. Ukuncika ekuvakashelweni yizinambuzane kwehlukene ngokwezitshalo nama-cultivar.

Ku-avocado, izimbali zinezigaba zesifazane nezesilisa. Ukuqhakaza okuhambisanayo nokuhamba kwempova kungasekela ukubamba kwezithelo, kodwa isimo sezulu nempilo yomuthi nakho kubalulekile.

Bheka izimbali nezivakashi ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi isidleke sisodwa sizoxazulula ukubamba okuncane kwezithelo.

11.en:
South Africa has Cape and African honeybee subspecies. Their natural ranges and movement restrictions matter when sourcing colonies.

Get help from an experienced local beekeeper before keeping or moving bees. Do not move colonies between regions on the strength of this lesson.

Both bee health and safe management need attention; a native colony is not automatically free of pests or disease.
11.zu:
INingizimu Afrika inezinhlobo zezinyosi ezibizwa nge-Cape ne-African honeybee. Izindawo zazo zemvelo nemikhawulo yokuzihambisa kubalulekile uma uthola ama-colony.

Thola usizo kumfuyi wezinyosi wendawo onolwazi ngaphambi kokugcina noma ukuhambisa izinyosi. Ungahambisi ama-colony phakathi kwezifunda ngenxa yalesi sifundo kuphela.

Impilo yezinyosi nokuphathwa okuphephile kudinga ukuqashelwa; i-colony yendabuko ayinazo ngokuzenzakalela izinambuzane noma izifo.

12.en:
Assess a possible hive site with an experienced local beekeeper before bringing bees onto the land.

Consider people, neighbours, livestock, paths, the flight path, water, forage, shelter and access for safe management. Morning sun may help, but one compass direction does not make a site safe.

Plan training and protective equipment as well as the hive position.
12.zu:
Hlola indawo engaba yesidleke nomfuyi wezinyosi wendawo onolwazi ngaphambi kokuletha izinyosi emhlabeni.

Cabanga ngabantu, omakhelwane, imfuyo, izindlela, indlela yokundiza, amanzi, izimbali, ukuvikeleka nendawo yokungena ukuphatha ngokuphepha. Ilanga lasekuseni lingasiza, kodwa uhlangothi olulodwa lwekhampasi alwenzi indawo iphephe.

Hlela ukuqeqeshwa nezimpahla zokuzivikela kanye nendawo yesidleke.

13.en:
Plan suitable flowering resources through the year and observe colony health with a trained beekeeper. A busy colony does not prove that the site is chemically clean.

Beekeepers must register with South Africa’s Department of Agriculture. Check its current registration and colony-movement requirements before starting, even with one hive.

Repeated swarming needs an experienced inspection. Space is one possible factor, not a diagnosis; do not attempt a split from this lesson alone.
13.zu:
Hlela izimbali ezifanele unyaka wonke, ubheke impilo ye-colony nomfuyi oqeqeshiwe. I-colony ematasa ayifakazeli ukuthi indawo ayinawo amakhemikhali.

Abafuyi bezinyosi kufanele babhalise ku-Department of Agriculture yaseNingizimu Afrika. Hlola izidingo zayo zamanje zokubhalisa nokuhambisa ama-colony ngaphambi kokuqala, noma unesidleke esisodwa.

Ukuphuma kwamaqembu ezinyosi ngokuphindaphindiwe kudinga ukuhlolwa onolwazi. Indawo ingaba yisici esisodwa, hhayi ukuxilongwa; ungazami ukuhlukanisa i-colony ngalesi sifundo kuphela.

15.en:
Use suitable farm-grown feed as part of a balanced diet, with clean water and daily care. Scraps and insects alone may not meet the animals’ needs.

Collect and manage manure so it does not contaminate food or water. Properly managed composting comes before using this material in the food-growing loop.

Record purchased feed, work and health costs as well as useful outputs. Integration can reduce waste; it does not automatically remove outside inputs.
15.zu:
Sebenzisa ukudla okufanele okukhiqizwe epulazini njengengxenye yokudla okunomsoco ophelele, namanzi ahlanzekile nokunakekelwa nsuku zonke. Izinsalela zokudla nezinambuzane kuphela kungase kungazanelisi izidingo zezilwane.

Qoqa uphathe umquba ukuze ungangcolisi ukudla noma amanzi. Ukwenza i-compost ngendlela ephethwe kahle kuza ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lezi zinsalela ohlelweni lokutshala ukudla.

Bhala ukudla okuthengiwe, umsebenzi nezindleko zempilo kanye nemikhiqizo ewusizo. Ukuhlanganisa kunganciphisa imfucuza; akuzisusi ngokuzenzakalela izinto ezivela ngaphandle.

16.en:
Guinea fowl forage for insects and may eat ticks, but their presence is not a dependable tick-control programme.

Protect livestock through regular observation and a veterinary parasite-management plan suited to the animals and site. Do not stop prescribed care because birds are present.

Also plan the flock’s feed, water, shelter, welfare and effects on neighbours.
16.zu:
Izimpangele zifuna izinambuzane futhi zingadla imikhaza, kodwa ukuba khona kwazo akulona uhlelo lokulawula imikhaza oluthembekile.

Vikela imfuyo ngokuyibheka njalo nangohlelo lwezilwane lokuphatha izimuncagazi olufanele izilwane nendawo. Ungayeki ukunakekelwa okunqunyiwe ngoba kunezinyoni.

Hlela nokudla, amanzi, indawo yokukhosela, inhlalakahle nomthelela komakhelwane.
16.title: Observe Livestock and Plan Parasite Care

18.en:
Do not rely on chickens following goats to prevent worms or replace treatment.

Work with a veterinarian or trained livestock adviser on grazing, monitoring, testing where appropriate and targeted treatment. Rotation needs to fit the parasite, season and grazing conditions.

Watch animal condition and keep records. An animal becoming weak or unwell needs prompt qualified attention.
18.zu:
Ungathembeli ezinkukhwini ezilandela izimbuzi ukuvimbela izikelemu noma ukuthatha indawo yokwelashwa.

Sebenzisana nodokotela wezilwane noma umeluleki wemfuyo oqeqeshiwe ngokuklama amadlelo, ukubheka izilwane, ukuhlola lapho kufanele khona nokwelashwa okuqondiwe. Ukushintshanisa amadlelo kudinga ukufanela isimuncagazi, isizini nezimo zamadlelo.

Bheka isimo sezilwane, ugcine amarekhodi. Isilwane esiba buthaka noma esigulayo sidinga ukunakwa onolwazi ngokushesha.
18.title: Manage Parasites With Evidence

20.en:
Choose one planning action before adding or moving animals.

Review an empty-bed rotation with a safe manure and harvest plan, assess a possible hive site with an experienced beekeeper, or record livestock condition for a veterinary discussion.

Write down feed, water, shelter, daily care, useful outputs and any costs. A useful farm link must also meet the animal’s needs and protect food safety.
20.zu:
Khetha isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlela ngaphambi kokwengeza noma ukuhambisa izilwane.

Buyekeza ukushintshanisa embhedeni ongenalutho ngohlelo oluphephile lomquba nesivuno, hlola indawo yesidleke nomfuyi wezinyosi onolwazi, noma bhala isimo semfuyo ukuze uxoxe nodokotela wezilwane.

Bhala ukudla, amanzi, indawo yokuhlala, ukunakekelwa kwansuku zonke, imikhiqizo ewusizo nezindleko. Ukuxhumanisa okuwusizo epulazini kufanele kwanelise izidingo zesilwane futhi kuvikele ukuphepha kokudla.
